figures.caption: Table 1: F1-score of GRISPwithQwen2.5 7B and relatedworks on Freebase and Wikidata benchmarks. Time is the average inference time of GRISP per query in seconds.

Figure 1: Training data synthesis for GRISP’s two inference stages using an exemplary training sample. Top left: Training sample with paired data. Bottom left: Skeleton generation training data built from the training sample by sampling a question and replacing the IRIs in the SPARQL query. Right: Re-ranking training data built from the training sample by randomly selecting an IRI, replacing it and all following IRIs in the SPARQL query with their natural-language placeholders, searching in the knowledge graph indices with the IRI’s natural-language label, and applying augmentations to the returned alternatives.
